INSERT INTO vocabulary_semantic_asset (id, language, normalized_term, semantic_json, related_terms_json, source_job_id, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES
(#{item.id}, 'en', #{item.normalizedTerm}, #{item.semanticJson}, #{item.relatedTermsJson}, #{item.sourceJobId}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE semantic_json = VALUES(semantic_json), related_terms_json = VALUES(related_terms_json), source_job_id = VALUES(source_job_id), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted = 0, version = version + 1
